verdict.rationale: Runpod's own docs say its CLI (runpodctl) is "an open source command-line tool," so some first-party source is readable. The core GPU cloud platform (Pods, Serverless, Clusters) shows no evidence of open source, and no license is named. Missing for 10: open-source availability of the core platform or service code, a named open license, a linked source repository, and independent corroboration.
